claim.quote: These tests reveal that the Higgs boson discovered ten years ago is remarkably consistent with the predictions of the theory and provide stringent constraints on many models of new phenomena beyond the Standard Model.

date.note: arXiv submission date; published as Nature 607 (2022) 52.

name: A detailed map of Higgs boson interactions, ten years after the discovery

significance.note: A combination paper reporting many measurements; no single significance is quoted in the abstract.

summary.plain: Ten years after finding it, ATLAS put together everything it had learned about the Higgs boson: how it is made, how it decays, and how closely all of that matches the theory. Everything still fits.
summary.technical: Combination of ATLAS Run 1 and Run 2 (up to 139 fb^-1 at 13 TeV) Higgs measurements: production and decay signal strengths across the main channels, mass and width constraints, and searches for beyond-Standard-Model couplings, published in Nature 607 (2022) 52.

title: A detailed map of Higgs boson interactions by the ATLAS experiment ten years after the discovery
why_it_matters: It is ATLAS's most complete single-experiment statement of the Higgs boson's properties, the benchmark that HL-LHC precision measurements will be compared against.
